text:
DSH Game Studio 

 
 Describe a small game in one sentence — play it in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar or build it in Codex / Claude Code / Antigravity, swap in AI art, and ship to Web, GitHub Pages, or WeChat Mini Games (< 4 MB). 
 15 agent tools • DSH + Codex + Claude Code + Antigravity • 2D and 3D voxel templates • OpenAI or Codex art • self-playing playtests • WeChat Mini Game export & CLI upload • GitHub Pages 
 

 
 English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia 
 

 
 Package: @zseven-w/dsh-game-studio · Current plugin release: 0.1.0-rc.6 · Tested with DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 & Codex / Claude Code MCP 
 🎮 Live Demo Game Wall (10 playable 2D & 3D games) · 📖 Multi-Host Setup (DSH / Codex / Claude / AGY) 
 

 

 
 
 

 
 
 
 The game plays in the right sidebar while the agent works; numbered AI art candidates wait under it for you to pick 

 Why DSH Game Studio

Ask the agent for a game in plain words — "a 3D game: a red panda collects bamboo shoots in a forest and dodges wild boars" — and it builds one from a template, plays it to check it works, and shows it in a sidebar you can play right away. Characters start as code-drawn models; when you want real art, the agent generates candidates with OpenAI or your Codex sign-in, you pick one by number, and the game swaps it in. Every change is a version you can go back to, and the finished game exports as a single offline HTML file.

 
 --- --- 
 🎮 Playable from the first answer Two templates — a 2D top-down game and the same loop in a 3D voxel world (three.js) — that the agent reshapes into the game you described: characters, rules, levels, screens. 
 🖥️ Live sidebar preview The game runs in a sandboxed panel next to the conversation, rebuilds on every change, and lists the art slots, candidates and versions under it. Landscape games get a wide stage. 
 🎨 Your own art, with a cost check first game studio generate asset makes numbered candidates per slot with the OpenAI image API or the local Codex CLI. Before anything is spent you get an approval card with the service, image count and expected cost. A picture you attach in chat can be the reference. 
 🤖 Self-playing playtests game studio playtest plays the latest code in a headless Chrome or Edge and reports phases, score, frame rate, script errors and screenshots. Games that are not steered with arrow keys (grids, cards, aiming, rhythm…) define window. autoplay , so the playtest plays their real loop. 
 🕰️ Version history Every build that changed the game is saved; game studio restore version brings back code, rules and art together. 
 📦 One-file Web export & WeChat Mini Game (< 4 MB) game studio export writes a zero-network HTML file; game studio export wechat builds a 🎮 Try 10 test games live in your browser (desktop or mobile): finiking.github.io/dsh-games/wall — or enter finiking/dsh-games under Online sources in your local Game Wall to subscribe and play them in your sidebar.

Four games from our test runs. Each started from the one sentence under it, in a fresh session (prompts translated from Chinese); later requests in the same session tweaked some of them, as noted. Gameplay is recorded with each game's own autoplay.

 
 
 
 Moonlit Fox: Lantern Isle — 3D voxel template, live gameplay 

 
 
 “Make a small game: a little fox collects lanterns in a moonlit forest and dodges thorn monsters.” 2D template; characters later swapped for picked AI art 
 “Make a 3D game: a little fox collects lanterns on a voxel island and dodges thorn monsters.” 3D voxel template; the lantern model was redone in a later request 
 
 
 “Make a 3D game: a little penguin collects fish on an iceberg and dodges seals.” 3D; a later request added the red hat 
 “Make a 3D game: a red panda collects bamboo shoots in a bamboo forest and dodges wild boars.” 3D; characters later swapped for AI art, the forest stays 3D 
 
 

 How well it works

Measured in a real DSH with DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, each game made from one sentence in a fresh session, scored by an independent playtest (2026-11-04/05):

- Collect-and-dodge games (the templates' home ground): 10 of 10 different requests were playable on the first try, median about 14 minutes per game.
- Other genres — match-3, box pushing, tower defense, basketball, platformer, rhythm, racing, card battle, farming, café management: all 10 came out playable, but took a median of about 26 minutes. After adding autoplay , custom art slots and landscape support, four of them were rerun and took 8–18 minutes. The sample is small.

 Tools

 Tool What it does 
 --- --- 
 game studio create Create a playable game from the collector (2D) or voxel (3D) template, build it and show it in the sidebar. Takes the title, an art style, orientation (portrait or landscape) and slots — the game's own art slots, named in the user's language. 
 game studio build Rebuild after editing game.json or game.js , refresh the preview and save a version with a short note. 
 game studio playtest Play the latest code headlessly (phone-shaped portrait or 960×540 landscape) and report phases, best score, hearts, fps, errors and screenshots; pass platform: "wechat" to simulate WeChat's top-right capsule safe area & single-WebGL constraint; characters: true returns close-ups only. 
 game studio generate asset Generate 1–4 candidate images for one slot with openai or codex , optionally following a reference picture. Asks for approval before spending. Codex runs in the background. 
 game studio apply asset Put a candidate into the game by its number, rebuild and refresh. 
 game studio revert asset Go back to a slot's previous art. 
 game studio versions List saved versions, newest first.

install.title: Install into DSH, Codex, Claude Code & Antigravity
install.html:
DeepSeek Harness (DSH — with Live Sidebar UI)
dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-game-studio@latest
dsh web
Codex / Claude Code / Antigravity / Grok CLI (Standalone MCP Plugin)
git clone https://github.com/ZSeven-W/dsh-game-studio.git
cd dsh-game-studio
npm install
npm run setup          # Codex (registers plugin + verifies all 15 tools via codex app-server)
npm run setup:claude   # Claude Code
npm run setup:agy      # Antigravity
npm run setup:all      # All hosts at once

See INSTALL.md for agent-copyable setup prompts and clean uninstall commands.
